en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Jamhour, from the one who mentioned it, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Sa’ad, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘There are two ears and the two eyes – (if) the two eyes sleep and the two ears do not sleep, that does not break the Ablution (Wudhu). So when the two eyes sleep and the two ears (sleep as well), the Ablution (Wudhu) breaks’.
en.sarwar: 16. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from ibn Jumhur from those whom he has mentioned from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Sa‘d who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
There are ears and eyes. Eyes may sleep but not yet the ears. This does not invalidate Wudu’. When both eyes and ears sleep, Wudu’ becomes invalid.’”
